messages.subject: Rattle Users - Stack Overflow support
messages.body_plain:
I have updated the rattle-users mailing list <https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/rattle-users> welcome message to encourage questions about Rattle on Stack Overflow <https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/rattle> which I will monitor and answer as well. Stack Overflow may have a larger user base to support crowd sourced answers and there have been a few Rattle questions there over the past little while with good answers. I will use the rattle-users mailing list mainly for announcements.

Speaking of which.... let me take this opportunity to remind data scientists that I also have a new template-based (i.e., programming by example) data science book The Essentials of Data Science <https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/1138088633/ref=as_li_tl?ie=UTF8&tag=togaware-20&camp=1789&creative=9325&linkCode=as2&creativeASIN=1138088633&linkId=c4d576a9a4977252dbfa09c4d0c01a9c>. This is a kind of progression on from doing data science through a GUI like Rattle, but still aiming to make it accessible through the use of templates and examples.

Finally, when posting questions please follow the Stack Overflow guidelines:
How to make a great r reproducible example <http://stackoverflow.com/questions/5963269/how-to-make-a-great-r-reproducible-example> and
How to create a Minimal, Complete, and Verifiable example <http://stackoverflow.com/help/mcve>
Thank you all for your support and encouragement.

Regards,
Graham

 install.packages("carioDevice")

Graham
